comment: A’s tenfold higher Adam rate supplied substantially more progress at this short budget. Among the remaining contenders, B’s three LayerNorms and normalized final block favored it over E, while E’s normalized residual architecture favored it over zero-LN D. C combined plain SGD with a long unnormalized tail and was weakest. K1003 and K1012 helped calibrate optimizer progress; K1020 and K1061 supplied conditional spiral architecture evidence. The gold supports their combined application here, but does not isolate normalization, residuals, or optimizer effects. No new general rule is warranted.
